quests.instruction: Give a one-sentence overview, then describe the eye-catching moving part.
quests.hint: Name the kind of display first, then say what the main feature is doing.
quests.explanation: An overview sentence followed by 'the main feature is...' is the first organized pattern: type of place, then the key detail.
quests.sceneText: Model Railway Display|toy train on the tracks|miniature station building|tiny painted trees
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a model railway display. The main feature is a small toy train running around a loop of tracks, past a miniature station and tiny painted trees.
acceptedSynonyms: toy train,train on the tracks,model train

quests.instruction: Give an overview of the shop, then describe the main feature that fills the back wall.
quests.hint: Start with what kind of shop it is, then say what stands out most.
quests.explanation: Naming the shop first and then the most noticeable object helps the listener place the details that follow.
quests.sceneText: Yarn Shop|basket of needles|knitted sample scarves|wall of yarn in many colors
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a yarn shop. The main thing you notice is a wall of yarn in many colors, arranged in neat rows, and there are knitted scarves and a basket of needles on the table in front.
options: Wall of yarn in many colors
acceptedSynonyms: wall of yarn,yarn wall,shelves of yarn
quests.correctAnswer: Wall of yarn in many colors

quests.instruction: Start with the kind of room, then describe the main instrument.
quests.hint: Give the room type in your first sentence, then the biggest object.
quests.explanation: 'This looks like...' opens with a general guess based on what is visible, and 'the main feature' introduces the object that matters most.
quests.sceneText: Observatory Room|rolling ladder|star charts on the wall|large brass telescope
quests.sampleAnswer: This looks like a small observatory. The main feature is a large brass telescope pointing toward a slot in the ceiling, and star charts are pinned to the wall beside it.
acceptedSynonyms: star charts,charts on the wall,star maps

quests.instruction: Start with what is in the background, then say what stands in front of it.
quests.hint: Use 'in the foreground' for the closest and 'in the background' for the farthest.
quests.explanation: 'In the foreground' and 'in the background' are the two words for depth, and the learner must place each object in the right layer.
quests.sceneText: Street Festival|girl holding a balloon|crowd behind a rope|tall parade banner
quests.sampleAnswer: In the foreground, a girl is holding a balloon. In the background, a crowd is standing behind a rope, and a tall banner hangs above them.
acceptedSynonyms: girl with a balloon,girl holding a balloon,child with a balloon
crowd,crowd behind a rope,people behind a rope

quests.instruction: Start with what is closest to us and work back.
quests.hint: Start with the foreground, then the middle, then the background.
quests.explanation: Describing from nearest to farthest gives the learner a natural order, and 'behind it' links the layers together.
quests.sceneText: Ranch Field|wooden fence in the foreground|grazing horses|mountains in the background
quests.sampleAnswer: In the foreground, a wooden fence runs across the picture. Behind it, a few horses are grazing, and in the background there are mountains.

quests.instruction: Find the animal between the foreground and the background and describe where it stands.
quests.hint: Describe the closest layer, then the middle, then the farthest.
quests.explanation: This task uses three layers (foreground, middle, background), and the learner places an animal in the middle.
quests.sceneText: Wetland Boardwalk|boardwalk in the foreground|heron standing in the water|tall reeds in the background
quests.sampleAnswer: A wooden boardwalk crosses the foreground. In the middle of the picture, a heron is standing in shallow water, and tall reeds fill the background.

quests.instruction: Describe the workshop starting near the entrance and moving toward the back. End with the largest machine.
quests.hint: Use 'near the front', 'along the wall', and 'toward the back'.
quests.explanation: 'Toward the back' and 'near the front' organize a room by depth, so the learner leads a listener from the entrance inward.
quests.sceneText: Locomotive Workshop|tool cabinets along the wall|oil barrel near the front|engine toward the back
quests.sampleAnswer: Near the front there's an oil barrel, and along the wall there are tool cabinets. Toward the back of the workshop stands a large engine on a stand.
acceptedSynonyms: tool cabinets,cabinets along the wall,tool storage

quests.instruction: Describe what is toward the center of the hall and what surrounds it.
quests.hint: Use 'toward the center', 'near the door', and 'toward the back'.
quests.explanation: 'Toward the center' and 'toward the back' give a relative position rather than an exact one, which is how people describe large spaces.
quests.sceneText: Community Hall|coat rack near the door|folding chairs in the center|small stage at the back
quests.sampleAnswer: Toward the center of the hall, folding chairs are set out in rows. Near the door there's a coat rack, and toward the back a small stage is raised above the floor.
acceptedSynonyms: coat rack,rack near the door,coat stand
folding chairs,chairs in rows,chairs in the center

quests.instruction: Describe the market hall starting with the entrance area toward the front.
quests.hint: Start at the front, move to the center, and finish at the back.
quests.explanation: The learner walks a listener through a hall from front to back, using a different position phrase each time.
quests.sceneText: Indoor Market Hall|fruit stalls toward the front|fish counters in the center|flower stand at the back
quests.sampleAnswer: Toward the front, fruit stalls line both sides of the aisle. In the center, there are fish counters, and toward the back there's a flower stand.
acceptedSynonyms: fruit stalls,stalls at the front,fruit stands
flower stand,flower stall,flowers at the back

quests.instruction: Use 'while' to describe what is happening at the table and in the corner at the same time. Start with the animal on the table.
quests.hint: Use 'while' to link the two areas, and name each animal's position.
quests.explanation: 'While' connects two activities in different parts of the same scene, so the learner describes the room as a whole and not as separate items.
quests.sceneText: Pet Grooming Room|dog being brushed on the table|dog waiting in a crate|row of grooming tools
quests.sampleAnswer: A woman is brushing a dog on the table, while another dog is waiting in a crate in the corner. Grooming tools are lined up on a shelf.
acceptedSynonyms: dog being brushed,dog on the table,dog being groomed
dog in a crate,waiting dog,dog in the corner
grooming tools,row of tools,brushes and combs

quests.instruction: Use 'meanwhile' to describe what is happening on the right while the crane is working on the left.
quests.hint: Start with the crane, then use 'meanwhile' for the truck and the people.
quests.explanation: 'Meanwhile' introduces a second activity happening at the same time in another part of the scene.
quests.sceneText: Building Site|crane lifting a beam|truck unloading bricks|workers in yellow vests
quests.sampleAnswer: On the left, a crane is lifting a steel beam. Meanwhile, on the right, a truck is unloading bricks, and two workers in yellow vests are watching.
acceptedSynonyms: workers in yellow vests,workers,people in vests

quests.instruction: Use 'meanwhile' to say what the boy is doing while the story is happening.
quests.hint: Describe the story first, then use 'meanwhile' for the boy.
quests.explanation: 'Meanwhile' is useful when one action is the main event and another happens quietly in the background.
quests.sceneText: Children's Reading Area|children sitting on cushions|woman reading aloud|boy choosing books
quests.sampleAnswer: A woman is reading aloud while several children sit on cushions and listen. Meanwhile, a boy at the shelves is choosing books.
acceptedSynonyms: woman reading aloud,woman reading,woman with a book
boy choosing books,boy at the shelves,boy with books

quests.instruction: Start with the main feature, then add supporting details.
quests.hint: Name the most important thing first, then add what is above it and what is next to it.
quests.explanation: Leading with the main feature and adding smaller details is the basic organization: important first, supporting later.
quests.sceneText: Village Well|wooden bucket on a rope|round stone well|coil of rope on the ground
quests.sampleAnswer: The main thing is a round stone well. A wooden bucket is hanging from a rope above it, and a coil of rope is lying on the ground.
options: Coil of rope on the ground
acceptedSynonyms: coil of rope,rope on the ground,rope

quests.instruction: Start with the centerpiece, then add what stands behind and beside it.
quests.hint: Say what the centerpiece is and where it is, then the supporting objects.
quests.explanation: The learner picks the most eye-catching item and describes the other two in relation to it.
quests.sceneText: Science Fair Booth|poster with diagrams|handwritten name card|model volcano in the center
quests.sampleAnswer: The centerpiece is a model volcano on the table. A poster with diagrams stands behind it, and a handwritten name card is placed at the front.

quests.instruction: Start with the biggest structure, then add two supporting details.
quests.hint: Say what the largest thing is, then use 'in front of' and 'against' for the others.
quests.explanation: The learner uses 'the main thing' plus two position phrases to place supporting details around a central structure.
quests.sceneText: Lakeside Cabin|log cabin|canoe pulled onto the shore|stack of firewood
quests.sampleAnswer: The main thing is a log cabin at the edge of the lake. A canoe is pulled up onto the shore in front of it, and a stack of firewood leans against the wall.
acceptedSynonyms: canoe,canoe on the shore,boat on the shore

quests.instruction: Start with an overview, then sweep from left to right and finish with the right side.
quests.hint: Give the place, then use 'on the left', 'in the middle', and 'on the right' in order.
quests.explanation: A left-to-right sweep combined with an overview gives a complete, easy-to-follow description of a single surface.
quests.sceneText: Shoemaker's Workbench|wooden shoe forms on the left|heavy sewing machine in the middle|finished boots on the right
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a shoemaker's workbench. On the left there are wooden shoe forms, in the middle there's a heavy sewing machine, and on the right a pair of finished boots is standing on a cloth.

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then sweep from left to right and end with the drums.
quests.hint: Name the shop, then move from left to right and end with the last item.
quests.explanation: The sweep pattern is the same, but the learner adds an overview and ends on a specific object.
quests.sceneText: Instrument Shop Wall|row of violins on the left|electric keyboards in the middle|full drum sets on the right
quests.sampleAnswer: This is an instrument shop. On the left, violins hang in a row, in the middle there are electric keyboards, and on the right two full drum sets are set up on a rug.

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then sweep left to right and describe the middle tank.
quests.hint: Describe the kind of shop, then each tank from left to right.
quests.explanation: The learner combines an overview with a left-middle-right sweep and gives each tank its own details.
quests.sceneText: Aquarium Shop|tank with turtles on the left|tank with tropical fish in the middle|tank of water plants on the right
quests.sampleAnswer: This is an aquarium shop with three tanks. On the left, turtles are resting on a rock, in the middle small tropical fish are swimming, and on the right there's a tank full of water plants.

quests.instruction: Describe the hall to someone who cannot see it, starting with what they would notice first.
quests.hint: Begin with 'The first thing you'd notice is...' and then go around the room.
quests.explanation: Describing for someone who cannot see requires putting the most obvious feature first and then giving directions to the rest.
quests.sceneText: Science Center Atrium|dinosaur skeleton hanging from the ceiling|ticket booth with a glass window|gift shop sign
quests.sampleAnswer: The first thing you'd notice is a giant dinosaur skeleton hanging from the ceiling. Below it, there's a ticket booth with a glass window on the right, and a gift shop sign hangs above a doorway on the left.
options: Ticket booth with a glass window
acceptedSynonyms: ticket booth,ticket window,booth with a glass window
gift shop sign,shop sign,sign above the door

quests.instruction: Describe the path to someone who cannot see it, starting with what is directly ahead.
quests.hint: Start with 'Straight ahead', then describe the sides and the end.
quests.explanation: 'Straight ahead' and 'at the end' give a blind listener a route, which is a very practical use of spatial description.
quests.sceneText: Garden Entrance|iron gate at the end|winding stone path|rose bushes along the walls
quests.sampleAnswer: Straight ahead there's a stone path winding toward the gate. On both sides, rose bushes grow along low walls, and the iron gate at the end is open.

quests.instruction: Describe the space to someone who cannot see it, starting with the largest piece of furniture.
quests.hint: Start with the biggest thing, then say where the others are in relation to it.
quests.explanation: The learner puts size first and then position, so a listener can build a mental layout piece by piece.
quests.sceneText: Coworking Space|long shared table|glass phone booths|row of beanbag seats
quests.sampleAnswer: The largest thing is a long shared table in the middle, with laptops spaced along it. Along the wall there are glass phone booths, and near the window a row of beanbag seats.

quests.instruction: Describe from closest to farthest, and finish with what is farthest away.
quests.hint: Use 'closest to us', 'in the middle', and 'far away in the distance'.
quests.explanation: 'Closest to us' and 'far away in the distance' mark the two ends of depth, so the learner ends the description at the horizon.
quests.sceneText: Country Road|fence post close to us|red barn in the middle|rolling hills in the distance
quests.sampleAnswer: Closest to us there's a fence post. In the middle of the picture, a red barn stands beside the road, and far away in the distance there are rolling hills.

quests.instruction: Start with the object closest to the viewer and work your way back.
quests.hint: Use 'beyond it' and 'far behind that' to move to the next layer.
quests.explanation: 'Beyond it' and 'far behind that' are linking phrases that move the description from one layer to the next.
quests.sceneText: City Skyline View|park bench in the foreground|bridge over the river|tall towers on the skyline
quests.sampleAnswer: Closest to us there's an empty park bench. Beyond it, a bridge crosses the river, and far behind that, tall towers form the skyline.

quests.instruction: Find the building in the middle distance and describe what is in front of and behind it.
quests.hint: Say what is in front of the cottage, then the cottage, then what is behind it.
quests.explanation: The learner describes three layers by placing one building between a fence and a forest.
quests.sceneText: Snowy Village View|snow-covered fence in front|small wooden cottage in the middle|dark pine forest behind
quests.sampleAnswer: In front of the cottage there's a fence covered with snow. The small wooden cottage stands in the middle of the picture, and behind it a dark pine forest covers the hill.

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then describe the main person and her action, then the supporting objects.
quests.hint: Overview first, then the main action, then the objects around her.
quests.explanation: This three-step organization (setting, action, supporting details) is the shape of a real spoken description.
quests.sceneText: Repair Table|toolbox lying open|woman repairing a toaster|man watching
quests.sampleAnswer: This looks like a repair workshop. A woman is repairing a toaster with a small screwdriver, and an open toolbox is next to her. A man is standing on the other side, watching.
acceptedSynonyms: woman repairing,woman with a toaster,woman fixing a toaster
man watching,man standing,man on the other side

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then the main person, then the objects around her.
quests.hint: Start with what kind of activity it is, then who is doing what, then what is around her.
quests.explanation: Describing the setting, then the main person, then the objects around her keeps a person-centered scene organized.
quests.sceneText: Music Lesson|music stand|chair pushed back|girl playing a flute
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a music lesson. A girl is playing a flute, standing in front of a music stand, and a chair is pushed back behind her.
acceptedSynonyms: girl playing a flute,girl with a flute,flute player

quests.instruction: Give an overview, then describe the man's action, then the supporting objects.
quests.hint: Start with the place, move to the man's action, and finish with what stands behind him.
quests.explanation: The learner ends on the supporting objects after the main action, which keeps the main action at the center of the description.
quests.sceneText: Farmyard|man scattering grain|wire chicken coop|bucket of grain
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a small farmyard. A man is scattering grain from a bucket, and chickens are gathering around his feet. Behind him there's a wire chicken coop.
acceptedSynonyms: man scattering grain,man feeding chickens,man with a bucket

quests.instruction: Describe this hall in five sentences: overview, location, major details, and supporting details. Begin with the large piece of furniture in the center.
quests.hint: Follow the order: overview, main object, entrance, sides, and one small detail.
quests.explanation: This consolidation task requires five organized sentences that move from overview to supporting details.
quests.sceneText: Hospital Reception|curved reception desk|automatic sliding doors|rows of waiting chairs
quests.sampleAnswer: This is the reception area of a hospital. A curved reception desk stands in the center of the hall, and two people are standing behind it. Automatic sliding doors are at the far end, while rows of waiting chairs line the left wall. A directory sign hangs above the desk.

quests.instruction: Describe the courtyard in five sentences: overview, the center, the edges, and one small detail.
quests.hint: Start with the whole space, then the middle, then the sides.
quests.explanation: The learner moves from the whole space to the center to the edges, and finishes with movement in the scene.
quests.sceneText: Courtyard|bike racks along one wall|large tree in the center|benches under the arches
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a courtyard with buildings on all sides. A large tree stands in the center, with a circular bench around its trunk. Along one wall there are bike racks, and under the arches on the opposite side there are more benches. A few people are walking across the paving stones.
acceptedSynonyms: bike racks,racks along the wall,bicycle racks
large tree,tree in the center,big tree

quests.instruction: Describe the showroom in five sentences and finish with the car on the platform.
quests.hint: Start with the whole showroom, then the glass wall and the smaller details, and finish with the car.
quests.explanation: The final task asks for a five-sentence description that saves the most important object for last, as a fluent speaker might do.
quests.sceneText: Car Showroom|price tags on the windshield|glass wall facing the street|silver sedan on a platform
quests.sampleAnswer: This is a car showroom with a high ceiling. A glass wall faces the street on the left, and a row of price tags is displayed on the windshields. Toward the back, a silver sedan sits on a low platform.
acceptedSynonyms: price tags,tags on the windshield,windshield tags
